findings.title: Legacy cycle page components still use purple/orange/indigo colors
findings.description: DevelopmentCyclePage.tsx, CycleView.tsx, FeedbackLog.tsx, and TicketBoard.tsx still contain purple-600, indigo-100/700, and orange color classes. These are in the old cycle page, not the new Orchestrator dashboard, but remain in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: Remove or update legacy cycle page components to match new color system, or delete if Orchestrator dashboard fully replaces them.

findings.title: Polling indicator causes full-page re-render every 1 second
findings.description: The secondsAgo state in OrchestratorCyclesPage increments every 1 second, causing the entire page component to re-render 5x more frequently than data actually updates (5s poll interval). Impact is minor but could be optimized.
findings.recommendation: Use a ref with manual DOM update or extract the ticker to a separate memoized component to avoid re-rendering the full page.

findings.title: Emoji characters used for icons in ActivityFeed and LearningsList
findings.description: ActivityFeed TYPE_ICONS and LearningsList CATEGORY_ICONS use emoji characters. Emoji rendering varies across platforms and may not be accessible to screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Replace emoji with SVG icons for cross-platform consistency.

findings.title: CycleLogStream warn level borderline contrast
findings.description: text-yellow-400 on gray-900 background has a contrast ratio of approximately 3.6:1, which passes WCAG AA for large text but not normal text.
findings.recommendation: Use text-yellow-300 for better contrast, matching the green-300 adjustment already made for info level.
